title: Employer Survey Questionnaire
purpose: This survey collects feedback for the Self-Assessment Report of the Mass Communication and Journalism Discipline. Your responses help improve teaching, facilities, and graduate outcomes.
confidentiality: This survey is strictly anonymous. Data will be aggregated for quality assurance purposes only. No individual will be identified in the reporting.
scale: 1 = Strongly Disagree / Very Poor | 2 = Disagree / Poor | 3 = Neutral / Average | 4 = Agree / Good | 5 = Strongly Agree / Excellent

questions.text: Graduates demonstrate sound knowledge relevant to media and communication work.
They possess strong research and information-gathering skills.
Their writing, production, or campaign work meets professional standards.
They communicate clearly with audiences and teams.
They can analyze complex situations and propose practical solutions.
They are proficient with relevant technology and tools.
They work well in teams and show leadership potential.
They adapt to changing media environments.
The curriculum appears relevant to current industry practice.
Graduates show evidence of practical training during their studies.
Interns from this program are well-prepared and eager to learn.
The university engages with employers to update the curriculum.
I am satisfied with the overall performance of these graduates.
